version.reason: The EVM target is what decides whether the grace-period name is reserved, so iterating targets shows both sides of the Cancun boundary.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc 0.8.36 declines the Frontier target outright ('Invalid EVM version requested'), which counts as a rejection, while slang accepts the declaration.

Before the fork reserves it, solc still warns that '"mcopy" will be promoted to Yul reserved identifier in the future'. Slang models the name as either reserved or free, with no grace-period warning, so it reports nothing on these targets. The pre-Constantinople targets additionally draw solc's 'Support for EVM versions older than constantinople is deprecated' warning.
